en:
Gonta and Kaito are gonna check the mansion's
surroundings and rooftop. I'll go to the salon.

So can the plain pair, Tsumugi and Shuichi,
go plainly search the dining hall and kitchen?

Sorry, Shuichi... It's my fault you 
got plain paired with me.

But everybody knows that the plain pair 
is just plain dangerous!
Ah, I don't know about that...
...Gonta go now.

It's surprisingly cold out there, so be careful.
You should come back here to warm up.

Thank you...but Gonta okay.
Gonta not smart enough to get sick.

Someone who isn't smart wouldn't want to save
everyone... They'd only think of themselves.
Oh...thank you.

Okaaay, let's stop the fun chit-chat and go back
to looking for the <CLT=cltSTRONG>secret of the outside world<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

But we don't know what's waiting for us,
so we gotta be veeeery careful, okay?
Alright, we'll start searching too.

Yeah...I want to hurry and find the <CLT=cltSTRONG>secret 
of the outside world<CLT=cltNORMAL> so we can go back...
I want to go back to my real body.
Well... These avatars aren't that bad, y'know?
Huh? These avatars?
Just kidding! It's just a joke! I'm just joking!

I'm gonna go check out the rooftop!
You guys better not slack off!
Gonta...go now, too.
Shuichi, we should go too.
Yeah, let's go.

<CLT=cltMIND>Maps of the mansion and the program world.
The smaller map is of the mansion.

<CLT=cltMIND>This is the entrance hall, and the room
with the phone is the salon.

<CLT=cltMIND>There's also a dining room, kitchen,
and bathroom on the first floor.

<CLT=cltMIND>There is no second floor, but there
is a rooftop area.

<CLT=cltMIND>This bigger map is of the entire
program world.

<CLT=cltMIND>This world is pretty expansive.
It even goes past the bridge...

<CLT=cltMIND>There's an ellipsis here...
Miu said she'd explain what that meant later.

<CLT=cltMIND>There's also another building in the
virtual world—a small chapel.

<CLT=cltMIND>What a strange clock...
Is this Miu's taste?

<CLT=cltMIND>No, it can't be. This world was originally
created by Monokuma...

<CLT=cltMIND>Tsumugi is waiting. I should
go to the dining room.
